question: Which challenge + funded + withdrawal policy maximizes total payouts net of all fees over a 24-month career (re-buying challenges after every failure or funded breach)?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-03 before any v7 simulation. Same rule snapshot, universes, buffer and simulator semantics as v5/v6; payout eligibility as v6. Results are per account in % of account size; holding several accounts multiplies payouts and fees but their paths are identical (same strategy), so breaches coincide; firm allocation caps apply. Historical seen data, descriptive; both samples must agree.
career: start on every 14th day; loop until the horizon: buy a challenge (pay fee) and run it; on failure buy again; on pass trade funded under the policy, withdrawing per the withdrawal rule, until breach (then buy again) or the horizon; profit left in an account at the horizon is counted at the split (as if withdrawn)

funded_variants.cppi: scale x 2 x (equity - floor) / annual vol, capped at the scale

withdrawal_rules.W_on_demand_1pct: withdraw as soon as profit >= 1% (and eligible)

choice_rule: per firm, the policy with the highest worst-case (over samples) mean net payout among those with p_net_positive >= 0.6 on both samples; non-BTC best reported separately
